title: Who’s News: Strategic Appointments at Quantum Computing Inc. and Quantinuum - Quantum Computing Report
gist: Quantum Computing Inc. (QCi) hired Susan Hunt as CRO and shifted former CRO Pouya Dianat into a new CPO role over photonics/semiconductor commercialization, while Quantinuum added a Chief Legal Officer and Chief People Officer as it builds out governance for life as a publicly listed entity.

themes.theme: QCi go-to-market and product leadership reshuffle

insights.claim: Quantum Computing Inc. (QCi) appointed Susan Hunt as Chief Revenue Officer, bringing over 30 years of enterprise sales and go-to-market experience across AI, cloud computing, and telecommunications from prior executive roles at Orbital Insight, Nuance Communications, LivePerson, Salesforce, and Sprint PCS.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: A CRO with deep enterprise AI/cloud/telecom sales pedigree signals QCi is prioritizing commercial scale-up and go-to-market execution, worth watching for revenue growth or new enterprise deal announcements.
insights.quote: Hunt brings over 30 years of experience in enterprise sales and go-to-market execution across AI, cloud computing, and telecommunications
insights.locator: Quantum Computing Inc. (QCi) has appointed Susan Hunt as Chief Revenue Officer (CRO).

insights.claim: QCi's former CRO Pouya Dianat has moved into a newly created Chief Product Officer role tasked with directing product strategy and managing the commercialization roadmap across the company's photonics and semiconductor portfolio.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Creating a dedicated CPO role over photonics and semiconductor commercialization suggests QCi views these product lines as its near-term revenue drivers, not just its quantum computing platform.
insights.quote: the newly created role of Chief Product Officer (CPO) to direct QCi’s product strategy and manage the commercialization roadmap across its photonics and semiconductor portfolio
insights.locator: Concurrently, former CRO Pouya Dianat has transitioned

themes.theme: Quantinuum executive buildout as a public company

insights.claim: Quantinuum appointed Robin Schulman as Chief Legal Officer and Company Secretary effective July 13, 2026, and Rory O'Byrne as Chief People Officer effective May 26, 2026, with both reporting to President and CEO Dr. Rajeeb Hazra.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Two senior C-suite hires reporting directly to the CEO indicate Quantinuum is formalizing its executive bench, a leading indicator of a company scaling operational maturity.
insights.quote: Both report to President and CEO Dr. Rajeeb Hazra.

insights.claim: Quantinuum's new Chief Legal Officer Robin Schulman previously served as Chief Legal Officer and Head of Corporate Affairs at GitLab, and as CLO at Couchbase and New Relic.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Recruiting legal leadership with public-tech-company experience (GitLab, New Relic) is a concrete signal Quantinuum is preparing its governance and compliance function for public-market scrutiny.
insights.quote: Schulman previously served as Chief Legal Officer and Head of Corporate Affairs at GitLab, as well as CLO at Couchbase and New Relic.

insights.claim: Quantinuum's new Chief People Officer Rory O'Byrne brings over 25 years of human resources experience and most recently served as Chief People Officer for Advanced Energy.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: HR leadership from an established public industrial company (Advanced Energy) points to Quantinuum investing in organizational scaling ahead of or alongside growth as a public entity.
insights.quote: O’Byrne brings over 25 years of human resources experience, most recently serving as Chief People Officer for Advanced Energy.

insights.claim: Quantinuum frames both the CLO and CPO appointments as supporting its organizational operations specifically as a publicly listed entity, indicating the company is operating under public-company governance and disclosure obligations.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Confirms Quantinuum's status as a publicly listed company, relevant context for investors tracking its disclosures, governance, and stock as distinct from privately-held quantum computing peers.
insights.quote: Both appointments support the company’s organizational operations as a publicly listed entity.
insights.locator: Both appointments support the company’s organizational operations
